description: Create a new underwriting package for a borrower and return deskUrl, dashboardUrl (hosted package page), and exportUrl (zip). Background checks may start automatically. Requires borrower, amount, currency, and security; a secured loan also needs a complete guarantee. Does not approve the loan. Human review remains required.

borrower.description: Legal name, ticker, or both. NASDAQ: OPTX and a trailing (OPTX) are the listed issuer. A private company name returns connectUrl and sources.

currency.description: ISO currency code, for example USD.

name: start_underwriting_package
title: Start underwriting package
